description: This is a Java unit test class for the SudoRetrieveThingsResponse class. It contains tests for immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and ensuring correct behavior of response status codes and command response types.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThingsResponseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SudoRetrieveThingsResponse, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and response behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of SudoRetrieveThingsResponse are immutable, and that related Thing instances are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the equals and hashCode implementations for SudoRetrieveThingsResponse.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullJsonArray
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SudoRetrieveThingsResponse with null JSON input throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: responseStatusCodeIsOk
methods.description: Checks that the response status code is HttpStatusCode.OK.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpectedJson
methods.description: Validates that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJson
methods.description: Tests that a SudoRetrieveThingsResponse instance can be correctly recreated from its JSON string.

methods.name: checkSudoCommandResponseTypeWorks
methods.description: Ensures that the response from JSON correctly identifies as a CommandResponse and matches the expected response.
